memories: Promised to put household security first.

households.name: Service workers
households.story: A steady wage supports a rented home. Reduced hours leave little room for surprises.

households.name: Workshop workers
households.story: Overseas orders keep the workshop busy. A family budget depends on the next shift.

households.name: Fixed-income renters
households.story: Income arrives regularly. Energy and food prices do not promise the same stability.

households.name: Property owners
households.story: Rent and outside income provide a cushion. Tenants’ ability to pay still matters.
